prompt: Audita el Brand Studio completo. Quiero saber qué gaps tiene para que el SDR pueda vender con la marca.

assertions.text: Output contains the required report sections: Executive Summary, Findings (with severity levels), Methodology Coverage Matrix, and SDR Readiness Score
Findings are categorized as CRITICAL, HIGH, or MEDIUM with specific items under each (not just headers)
References at least 4 of the 6 primary brand frameworks: Aaker, Keller, Gad, Neumeier, Brand Love Key, StoryBrand
Cites real file paths, field names, and model structures from the Nicolify codebase (not generic advice)
Identifies at least 3 genuine gaps in the brand schema that would limit AI agent effectiveness
Includes an SDR readiness evaluation showing which sales questions can/cannot be answered with current brand data
Recommendations are specific and actionable: they name exact files to modify, fields to add/change, and what the extraction prompt should capture
